harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: «إذا»: adverbial and conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the meaning of the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) «سبِّح».

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The clause «يدخلون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الناس, and «أفواجًا» is a ḥāl from the wāw.

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The preposition «بحمد» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «سَبِّح», and the clause «إنه كان توابا» is resumptive.
